steps.log: lightbox wheel zoom: transform the image under the cursor

steps.eval: (() => { document.querySelector('[data-dsh-test-viewer]')?.remove(); const overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.setAttribute('data-dsh-test-viewer', ''); overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6)'; overlay.setAttribute('role','dialog'); overlay.setAttribute('aria-modal','true'); const image = document.createElement('img'); image.src = '/chat-backgrounds/files/sample-background.png'; image.style.cssText = 'width:480px;height:300px'; overlay.appendChild(image); document.body.appendChild(overlay); const rect = image.getBoundingClientRect(); image.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: -300, clientX: rect.left + rect.width / 2, clientY: rect.top + rect.height / 2, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return JSON.stringify({ transform: image.style.transform, marker: image.getAttribute('data-dsh-image-zoom') }); })()

steps.check: wheel over a fixed image viewer scales the image
steps.expr: (() => { const image = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-test-viewer] img'); if (image === null) return false; const scale = Number(image.getAttribute('data-dsh-image-zoom')); return Number.isFinite(scale) && scale > 1 && (image.style.transform || '').includes('scale('); })()

steps.check: wheel up zooms in and wheel down zooms out monotonically
steps.expr: (() => { const s = JSON.parse(window.__zoomScales ?? 'null'); return s !== null && s[0] === null && s[1] > 1 && s[2] > s[1] && s[3] < s[2] && s[4] < s[3]; })()

steps.check: the point under the cursor stays anchored while zooming
steps.expr: (() => { const a = JSON.parse(window.__zoomAnchor ?? 'null'); return a !== null && a.scale > 1 && a.delta <= 2; })()

steps.check: wheeling the lightbox backdrop still zooms the preview
line-mode wheel deltas are normalized to a visible zoom step

steps.eval: (() => { const image = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-test-viewer] img'); const rect = image.getBoundingClientRect(); image.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', { clientX: rect.left + 10, clientY: rect.top + 10, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return JSON.stringify({ transform: image.style.transform, marker: image.getAttribute('data-dsh-image-zoom') }); })()

steps.check: double click resets the lightbox zoom
steps.expr: (() => { const image = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-test-viewer] img'); return image !== null && image.style.transform === '' && image.getAttribute('data-dsh-image-zoom') === null; })()

steps.check: wheeling an image inside a settings-style modal does not zoom it
steps.expr: (() => { const image = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-test-settings] img'); return image !== null && image.getAttribute('data-dsh-image-zoom') === null && (image.style.transform || '') === ''; })()

steps.log: inline images and the page itself keep their normal wheel behaviour

steps.eval: (() => { const overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.setAttribute('data-dsh-test-viewer', ''); overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6)'; overlay.setAttribute('role','dialog'); overlay.setAttribute('aria-modal','true'); const image = document.createElement('img'); image.src = '/chat-backgrounds/files/sample-background.png'; image.style.cssText = 'width:480px;height:300px'; overlay.appendChild(image); document.body.appendChild(overlay); const before = window.scrollY; image.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: -300, clientX: 10, clientY: 10, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return JSON.stringify({ scale: image.getAttribute('data-dsh-image-zoom'), scrollY: window.scrollY, before }); })()

steps.check: the scaled image is still owned by the viewer (no layout scroll)
steps.expr: (() => { const image = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-test-viewer] img'); const scale = Number(image?.getAttribute('data-dsh-image-zoom')); return Number.isFinite(scale) && scale <= 8 && scale >= 0.4; })()

steps.log: right sidebar preview: a plain wheel is translated into its Ctrl+wheel gesture

steps.eval: (() => { const scrollport = document.createElement('div'); scrollport.setAttribute('data-document-zoom-scrollport',''); scrollport.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:20px;top:120px;width:200px;height:120px;z-index:2147483000;overflow:auto'; const surface = document.createElement('div'); surface.setAttribute('data-image-preview',''); const image = document.createElement('img'); image.src='/chat-backgrounds/files/sample-background.png'; image.style.cssText='width:100px;height:60px'; surface.appendChild(image); scrollport.appendChild(surface); document.body.appendChild(scrollport); window.__zoomProbe = { ctrl: 0, plain: 0 }; scrollport.addEventListener('wheel', (event) => { if (event.ctrlKey) window.__zoomProbe.ctrl += 1; else window.__zoomProbe.plain += 1; }); const rect = image.getBoundingClientRect(); image.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: -120, clientX: rect.left + 10, clientY: rect.top + 10, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return JSON.stringify(window.__zoomProbe); })()

steps.check: inline images are not zoomed by the gesture
steps.expr: (() => { const image = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-test-inline] img'); return image !== null && image.getAttribute('data-dsh-image-zoom') === null; })()

steps.check: the plugin exposes the zoom feature in diagnostics only implicitly (no settings switch)
steps.expr: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dshcb-section .dshcb-row')].map((row) => row.querySelector('.dshcb-title')?.innerText.trim()); return !rows.includes('图片滚轮缩放'); })()
